    "# Лабораторная работа 7\n",
    "# Группа 81, Вариант 19\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "!pip install numpy scipy matplotlib pandas simpy -q\n",
    "\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from scipy.stats import expon, erlang\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import simpy\n",
    "import heapq\n",
    "from collections import deque\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
    "\n",
    "# Настройка отображения\n",
    "plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12\n",
    "plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (14, 8)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "print(\"ГЕНЕРАЦИЯ ПАРАМЕТРОВ ДЛЯ ВАРИАНТА 19 (ЗАДАНИЕ 1)\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Фиксируем seed для воспроизводимости (вариант 19)\n",
    "np.random.seed(19 + 2026543)  # как в R коде\n",
    "\n",
    "# Генерация параметров\n",
    "m = np.random.choice(range(6, 21), 1)[0]      # количество типов программ (6-20)\n",
    "lambda_val = np.random.uniform(0.1, 2)        # интенсивность входящего потока\n",
    "Q = np.random.exponential(1/0.3, m)           # трудоёмкости программ (exp со средним 1/0.3)\n",
    "q = np.random.choice(range(1, 5), 1)[0]       # квант времени для RR (1-4)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nСгенерированные параметры для варианта 19:\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"  • Количество типов программ (m) = {m}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Интенсивность входящего потока (λ) = {lambda_val:.6f} заявок/ед.времени\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Квант времени для RR (q) = {q}\")\n",
    "print(f\"\\nТрудоёмкости программ Q_i:\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "for i, qi in enumerate(Q):\n",
    "    print(f\"  Тип {i+1}: {qi:.6f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"\\n  Средняя трудоёмкость: {np.mean(Q):.6f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Минимальная: {np.min(Q):.6f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  Максимальная: {np.max(Q):.6f}\")"
   ]

      "\n",
      "МОДЕЛЬ: Однопроцессорная система с неограниченной очередью\n",
      "--------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "Характеристики:\n",
      "  • Один процессор (канал обслуживания)\n",
      "  • Неограниченная очередь (бесконечная длина)\n",
      "  • Входящий поток - простейший с интенсивностью λ\n",
      "  • m типов программ с различной трудоёмкостью Q_i\n",
      "  • Время обслуживания - случайная величина\n",
      "\n",
      "АЛГОРИТМЫ ПЛАНИРОВАНИЯ:\n",
      "--------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "\n",
      "1. FCFS (First Come First Served) / FIFO:\n",
      "   • Заявки обслуживаются в порядке поступления\n",
      "   • Самый простой алгоритм\n",
      "   • Используется как базовый для сравнения\n",
      "\n",
      "2. SPT (Shortest Processing Time):\n",
      "   • Выбирается заявка с наименьшей трудоёмкостью\n",
      "   • Минимизирует среднее время ожидания\n",
      "   • Может вызвать \"голодание\" длинных заявок\n",
      "\n",
      "3. RR (Round Robin):\n",
      "   • Каждая заявка получает квант времени q\n",
      "   • Если заявка не завершилась, она становится в конец очереди\n",
      "   • Обеспечивает справедливое распределение процессора\n",
      "   • q - важный параметр, влияющий на производительность\n",
      "\n",
      "СРАВНЕНИЕ АЛГОРИТМОВ:\n",
      "--------------------------------------------------------\n",
      "Критерии сравнения:\n",
      "  • Среднее время обслуживания (включая ожидание)\n",
      "  • Дисперсия времени обслуживания\n",
      "  • Честность (отсутствие голодания)\n",
      "  • Эффективность (пропускная способность)\n",
      "\n"

   "source": [
    "# === ТЕОРЕТИЧЕСКИЙ РАСЧЁТ ===\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "print(\"ТЕОРЕТИЧЕСКИЙ РАСЧЁТ (СМО M/G/1/∞)\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Для одноканальной СМО с неограниченной очередью (M/G/1/∞)\n",
    "# Без учёта трудоёмкостей считаем время обслуживания случайной величиной\n",
    "\n",
    "# 1. Математическое ожидание времени обслуживания\n",
    "E_S = np.mean(Q)  # средняя трудоёмкость\n",
    "\n",
    "# 2. Второй начальный момент времени обслуживания\n",
    "E_S2 = np.mean(np.square(Q))\n",
    "\n",
    "# 3. Интенсивность входящего потока\n",
    "rho = lambda_val * E_S  # загрузка системы\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"Параметры для M/G/1 системы:\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"  • Интенсивность входа (λ) = {lambda_val:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее время обслуживания (E[S]) = {E_S:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Второй момент (E[S²]) = {E_S2:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Загрузка системы (ρ) = {rho:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "if rho >= 1:\n",
    "    print(f\"\\n  ВНИМАНИЕ: ρ >= 1, система нестабильна!\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\\n  Система стабильна (ρ < 1)\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Формула Поллачека-Хинчина для M/G/1\n",
    "# Среднее время ожидания в очереди\n",
    "if rho < 1:\n",
    "    Wq = (lambda_val * E_S2) / (2 * (1 - rho))\n",
    "    # Среднее время в системе\n",
    "    W_theory = Wq + E_S\n",
    "    # Среднее число заявок в системе\n",
    "    L_theory = lambda_val * W_theory\n",
    "    # Средняя длина очереди\n",
    "    Lq_theory = lambda_val * Wq\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"\\nРЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ ТЕОРЕТИЧЕСКОГО РАСЧЁТА (M/G/1):\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
    "    print(f\"\\n1. Среднее время ожидания в очереди (Wq):\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   {Wq:.4f} ед.времени\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"\\n2. Среднее время в системе (W):\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   {W_theory:.4f} ед.времени\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"\\n3. Среднее число заявок в системе (L):\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   {L_theory:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"\\n4. Средняя длина очереди (Lq):\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   {Lq_theory:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(f\"\\n5. Абсолютная пропускная способность (A):\")\n",
    "    print(f\"   {lambda_val:.4f} заявок/ед.времени\")\n",
    "else:\n",
    "    print(f\"\\nСистема нестабильна, теоретический расчёт невозможен!\")\n",
    "    W_theory = float('inf')\n",

    "# === ИМИТАЦИОННОЕ МОДЕЛИРОВАНИЕ ===\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",

    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "class FCFSSystem:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Система с алгоритмом FCFS (First Come First Served)\"\"\"\n",
    "    def __init__(self, env, lambda_val, Q_list):\n",
    "        self.env = env\n",
    "        self.lambda_val = lambda_val\n",
    "        self.Q_list = Q_list\n",
    "        self.processor = simpy.Resource(env, capacity=1)\n",
    "        self.queue = simpy.Store(env)\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.completed = 0\n",
    "        self.wait_times = []\n",
    "        self.system_times = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    def request(self, job_id, service_time):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Обработка одной заявки\"\"\"\n",
    "        arrival_time = self.env.now\n",
    "\n",
    "        with self.processor.request() as req:\n",
    "            yield req\n",
    "            wait_time = self.env.now - arrival_time\n",
    "            self.wait_times.append(wait_time)\n",
    "\n",
    "            yield self.env.timeout(service_time)\n",
    "            self.system_times.append(self.env.now - arrival_time)\n",
    "            self.completed += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "    def generate_jobs(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Генератор заявок\"\"\"\n",
    "        job_id = 0\n",
    "        while True:\n",
    "            interarrival = np.random.exponential(1 / self.lambda_val)\n",
    "            yield self.env.timeout(interarrival)\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Выбираем случайный тип программы\n",
    "            service_time = np.random.choice(self.Q_list)\n",
    "            self.env.process(self.request(f\"job_{job_id}\", service_time))\n",
    "            job_id += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "class SPTSystem:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Система с алгоритмом SPT (Shortest Processing Time)\"\"\"\n",
    "    def __init__(self, env, lambda_val, Q_list):\n",
    "        self.env = env\n",
    "        self.lambda_val = lambda_val\n",
    "        self.Q_list = Q_list\n",
    "        self.processor_free = True\n",
    "        self.queue = []  # приоритетная очередь (heapq)\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.completed = 0\n",
    "        self.wait_times = []\n",
    "        self.system_times = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    def add_job(self, job_id, service_time):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Добавление заявки в очередь\"\"\"\n",
    "        heapq.heappush(self.queue, (service_time, job_id, self.env.now))\n",
    "        if self.processor_free:\n",
    "            self.env.process(self.process_jobs())\n",
    "\n",
    "    def process_jobs(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Обработка заявок в порядке приоритета\"\"\"\n",
    "        self.processor_free = False\n",
    "\n",
    "        while self.queue:\n",
    "            service_time, job_id, arrival_time = heapq.heappop(self.queue)\n",
    "            wait_time = self.env.now - arrival_time\n",
    "            self.wait_times.append(wait_time)\n",
    "\n",
    "            yield self.env.timeout(service_time)\n",
    "            self.system_times.append(self.env.now - arrival_time)\n",
    "            self.completed += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.processor_free = True\n",
    "\n",
    "    def generate_jobs(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Генератор заявок\"\"\"\n",
    "        job_id = 0\n",
    "        while True:\n",
    "            interarrival = np.random.exponential(1 / self.lambda_val)\n",
    "            yield self.env.timeout(interarrival)\n",
    "\n",
    "            service_time = np.random.choice(self.Q_list)\n",
    "            self.add_job(f\"job_{job_id}\", service_time)\n",
    "            job_id += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "class RRSystem:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Система с алгоритмом RR (Round Robin)\"\"\"\n",
    "    def __init__(self, env, lambda_val, Q_list, quantum):\n",
    "        self.env = env\n",
    "        self.lambda_val = lambda_val\n",
    "        self.Q_list = Q_list\n",
    "        self.quantum = quantum\n",
    "        self.processor_free = True\n",
    "        self.queue = deque()  # обычная очередь\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.completed = 0\n",
    "        self.wait_times = []\n",
    "        self.system_times = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    def add_job(self, job_id, service_time):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Добавление заявки в очередь\"\"\"\n",
    "        self.queue.append({\n",
    "            'job_id': job_id,\n",
    "            'remaining_time': service_time,\n",
    "            'arrival_time': self.env.now\n",
    "        })\n",
    "        if self.processor_free:\n",
    "            self.env.process(self.process_jobs())\n",
    "\n",
    "    def process_jobs(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Обработка заявок с квантованием времени\"\"\"\n",
    "        self.processor_free = False\n",
    "\n",
    "        while self.queue:\n",
    "            job = self.queue.popleft()\n",
    "\n",
    "            wait_time = self.env.now - job['arrival_time']\n",
    "            self.wait_times.append(wait_time)\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Выполняем квант времени\n",
    "            execution_time = min(job['remaining_time'], self.quantum)\n",
    "            yield self.env.timeout(execution_time)\n",
    "            job['remaining_time'] -= execution_time\n",
    "\n",
    "            if job['remaining_time'] <= 1e-10:\n",
    "                # Заявка завершена\n",
    "                self.system_times.append(self.env.now - job['arrival_time'])\n",
    "                self.completed += 1\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                # Заявка не завершена, ставим в конец очереди\n",
    "                job['arrival_time'] = self.env.now  # обновляем время прихода в очередь\n",
    "                self.queue.append(job)\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.processor_free = True\n",
    "\n",
    "    def generate_jobs(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Генератор заявок\"\"\"\n",
    "        job_id = 0\n",
    "        while True:\n",
    "            interarrival = np.random.exponential(1 / self.lambda_val)\n",
    "            yield self.env.timeout(interarrival)\n",
    "\n",
    "            service_time = np.random.choice(self.Q_list)\n",
    "            self.add_job(f\"job_{job_id}\", service_time)\n",
    "            job_id += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def run_simulation(system_class, *args, sim_time=50000):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Запуск имитационного моделирования\"\"\"\n",
    "    env = simpy.Environment()\n",
    "\n",
    "    if system_class == FCFSSystem:\n",
    "        system = system_class(env, *args)\n",
    "    elif system_class == SPTSystem:\n",
    "        system = system_class(env, *args)\n",
    "    elif system_class == RRSystem:\n",
    "        system = system_class(env, *args)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        raise ValueError(\"Unknown system class\")\n",
    "\n",
    "    env.process(system.generate_jobs())\n",
    "    env.run(until=sim_time)\n",
    "\n",
    "    return system\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "SIM_TIME = 50000\n",
    "print(f\"\\nЗапуск моделирования на {SIM_TIME} ед.времени...\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# FCFS\n",
    "print(\"\\n1. Моделирование FCFS...\")\n",
    "fcfs_system = run_simulation(FCFSSystem, lambda_val, Q)\n",
    "W_fcfs = np.mean(fcfs_system.system_times) if fcfs_system.system_times else 0\n",
    "Wq_fcfs = np.mean(fcfs_system.wait_times) if fcfs_system.wait_times else 0\n",
    "L_fcfs = lambda_val * W_fcfs\n",
    "completed_fcfs = fcfs_system.completed\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nРЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ FCFS:\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"  • Обслужено заявок: {completed_fcfs}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее время в системе (W): {W_fcfs:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее время в очереди (Wq): {Wq_fcfs:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее число заявок (L): {L_fcfs:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# SPT\n",
    "print(\"\\n2. Моделирование SPT...\")\n",
    "spt_system = run_simulation(SPTSystem, lambda_val, Q)\n",
    "W_spt = np.mean(spt_system.system_times) if spt_system.system_times else 0\n",
    "Wq_spt = np.mean(spt_system.wait_times) if spt_system.wait_times else 0\n",
    "L_spt = lambda_val * W_spt\n",
    "completed_spt = spt_system.completed\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nРЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ SPT:\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"  • Обслужено заявок: {completed_spt}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее время в системе (W): {W_spt:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее время в очереди (Wq): {Wq_spt:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее число заявок (L): {L_spt:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# RR\n",
    "print(f\"\\n3. Моделирование RR (квант = {q})...\")\n",
    "rr_system = run_simulation(RRSystem, lambda_val, Q, q)\n",
    "W_rr = np.mean(rr_system.system_times) if rr_system.system_times else 0\n",
    "Wq_rr = np.mean(rr_system.wait_times) if rr_system.wait_times else 0\n",
    "L_rr = lambda_val * W_rr\n",
    "completed_rr = rr_system.completed\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nРЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ RR (q={q}):\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"  • Обслужено заявок: {completed_rr}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее время в системе (W): {W_rr:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее время в очереди (Wq): {Wq_rr:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее число заявок (L): {L_rr:.4f}\")"
   ]

    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from scipy.stats import expon, erlang\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import simpy\n",
    "import heapq\n",
    "from collections import deque\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
    "\n",
    "# === АНАЛИЗ ВЛИЯНИЯ КВАНТА ВРЕМЕНИ ===\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "print(\"АНАЛИЗ ВЛИЯНИЯ КВАНТА ВРЕМЕНИ В RR\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "\n",
    "def analyze_quantum_effect(lambda_val, Q_list, quantum_range, sim_time=20000):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Анализ влияния кванта времени на производительность RR\"\"\"\n",
    "    results = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    for quantum in quantum_range:\n",
    "        print(f\"  Тестирование кванта {quantum}...\")\n",
    "        rr_system = run_simulation(RRSystem, lambda_val, Q_list, quantum, sim_time=sim_time)\n",
    "\n",
    "        W = np.mean(rr_system.system_times) if rr_system.system_times else 0\n",
    "        Wq = np.mean(rr_system.wait_times) if rr_system.wait_times else 0\n",
    "        completed = rr_system.completed\n",
    "\n",
    "        results.append({\n",
    "            'quantum': quantum,\n",
    "            'W': W,\n",
    "            'Wq': Wq,\n",
    "            'throughput': completed / sim_time\n",
    "        })\n",
    "\n",
    "    return results\n",
    "\n",
    "# Диапазон квантов времени\n",
    "quantum_range = range(1, 21)  # от 1 до 20\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nАнализ влияния кванта времени от {min(quantum_range)} до {max(quantum_range)}...\")\n",
    "quantum_results = analyze_quantum_effect(lambda_val, Q, quantum_range, sim_time=30000)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Преобразуем в DataFrame\n",
    "df_quantum = pd.DataFrame(quantum_results)\n",
    "\n",
    "# Находим оптимальный квант\n",
    "optimal_idx = df_quantum['W'].idxmin()\n",
    "optimal_quantum = df_quantum.loc[optimal_idx, 'quantum']\n",
    "optimal_W = df_quantum.loc[optimal_idx, 'W']\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nРЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ АНАЛИЗА:\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"  • Оптимальный квант: q* = {int(optimal_quantum)}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Минимальное среднее время в системе: W_min = {optimal_W:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Текущий квант (из условия): q = {q}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Текущее W(q={q}): {df_quantum[df_quantum['quantum']==q]['W'].values[0]:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "# Визуализация\n",
    "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))\n",
    "\n",
    "# График 1: Влияние кванта на W\n",
    "axes[0].plot(df_quantum['quantum'], df_quantum['W'], 'b-o', linewidth=2, markersize=6)\n",

    "\n",

    "print(f\"  • Распределение входящего потока: {input_dist}\")\n",

    "\n",
    "# Загрузка системы\n",
    "rho2 = lambda_val2 / (N * mu2)\n",

    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "from scipy.stats import expon, erlang\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import simpy\n",
    "import heapq\n",
    "from collections import deque\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "import math # Added for factorial function\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
    "\n",
    "# === МЕТОД ЭТАПОВ (АППРОКСИМАЦИЯ ПОТОКОВ ЭРЛАНГА) ===\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "print(\"МЕТОД ЭТАПОВ (АППРОКСИМАЦИЯ ЭРЛАНГОМ)\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "\n",
    "def erlang_stage_method(N, M, lambda_val, mu, input_dist, output_dist):\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    Расчёт характеристик методом этапов\n",
    "    (аппроксимация немарковских распределений)\n",
    "    \"\"\"\n",
    "    # Определяем количество этапов\n",
    "    if input_dist == \"M\":\n",
    "        k_input = 1\n",
    "        lambda_eff = lambda_val\n",
    "    elif input_dist == \"E_2\":\n",
    "        k_input = 2\n",
    "        lambda_eff = 2 * lambda_val\n",
    "    elif input_dist == \"E_3\":\n",
    "        k_input = 3\n",
    "        lambda_eff = 3 * lambda_val\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        k_input = 1\n",
    "        lambda_eff = lambda_val\n",
    "\n",
    "    if output_dist == \"M\":\n",
    "        k_output = 1\n",
    "        mu_eff = mu\n",
    "    elif output_dist == \"E_2\":\n",
    "        k_output = 2\n",
    "        mu_eff = 2 * mu\n",
    "    elif output_dist == \"E_3\":\n",
    "        k_output = 3\n",
    "        mu_eff = 3 * mu\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        k_output = 1\n",
    "        mu_eff = mu\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Приведённая интенсивность\n",
    "    rho_eff = (lambda_eff / k_input) / (mu_eff / k_output) if k_output > 0 else 0\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Для многоканальной СМО с ограниченной очередью\n",
    "    # Используем формулы Эрланга-Кендалла\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Вероятность простоя (приближённая)\n",
    "    if rho_eff < 1:\n",
    "        # Формулы для M/M/N/m с аппроксимацией\n",
    "        # Через марковскую цепь с расширенным пространством состояний\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Упрощённая аппроксимация\n",
    "        P0 = 1 / (1 + sum([(lambda_eff/mu_eff)**i / math.factorial(i) for i in range(1, N+1)]) +\n",
    "                 (lambda_eff/mu_eff)**N / math.factorial(N) *\n",
    "                 (1 - (rho_eff/N)**(M+1)) / (1 - rho_eff/N))\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        P0 = 0\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Абсолютная пропускная способность\n",
    "    A_eff = lambda_eff * (1 - P0) if P0 < 1 else 0\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Среднее число заявок в системе\n",
    "    L_eff = 0\n",
    "    for i in range(1, N + M + 1):\n",
    "        if i <= N:\n",
    "            L_eff += i * (lambda_eff/mu_eff)**i / math.factorial(i) * P0\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            L_eff += i * (lambda_eff/mu_eff)**i / (math.factorial(N) * N**(i-N)) * P0\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Среднее время в системе (формула Литтла)\n",
    "    W_eff = L_eff / A_eff if A_eff > 0 else 0\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Средняя длина очереди\n",
    "    Lq_eff = 0\n",
    "    for i in range(N, N + M + 1):\n",
    "        Lq_eff += (i - N) * (lambda_eff/mu_eff)**i / (math.factorial(N) * N**(i-N)) * P0\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Среднее время в очереди\n",
    "    Wq_eff = Lq_eff / A_eff if A_eff > 0 else 0\n",
    "\n",
    "    return {\n",
    "        'A': A_eff,\n",
    "        'L': L_eff,\n",
    "        'Lq': Lq_eff,\n",
    "        'W': W_eff,\n",
    "        'Wq': Wq_eff,\n",
    "        'P0': P0,\n",
    "        'rho': rho_eff,\n",
    "        'k_input': k_input,\n",
    "        'k_output': k_output\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Расчёт методом этапов\n",
    "stage_results = erlang_stage_method(N, M, lambda_val2, mu2, input_dist, output_dist)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nРЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ РАСЧЁТА (МЕТОД ЭТАПОВ):\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"\\nАппроксимация:\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Входной поток: {input_dist} → {stage_results['k_input']} этапов\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Обслуживание: {output_dist} → {stage_results['k_output']} этапов\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Приведённая загрузка: {stage_results['rho']:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nХАРАКТЕРИСТИКИ СИСТЕМЫ:\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"\\n1. Среднее время нахождения заявки в системе (W):\")\n",
    "print(f\"   {stage_results['W']:.4f} ед.времени\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n2. Среднее количество заявок в системе (L):\")\n",
    "print(f\"   {stage_results['L']:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n3. Среднее время нахождения в очереди (Wq):\")\n",
    "print(f\"   {stage_results['Wq']:.4f} ед.времени\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n4. Средняя длина очереди (Lq):\")\n",
    "print(f\"   {stage_results['Lq']:.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n5. Абсолютная пропускная способность (A):\")\n",
    "print(f\"   {stage_results['A']:.4f} заявок/ед.времени\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\n6. Вероятность простоя (P0):\")\n",
    "print(f\"   {stage_results['P0']:.4f} ({stage_results['P0']*100:.2f}%)\")"
   ]

    "# === ИМИТАЦИОННОЕ МОДЕЛИРОВАНИЕ МНОГОКАНАЛЬНОЙ СМО ===\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "print(\"ИМИТАЦИОННОЕ МОДЕЛИРОВАНИЕ МНОГОКАНАЛЬНОЙ СМО\")\n",
    "print(\"=\" * 80)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "class MultiServerQueue:\n",
    "    \"\"\"Многоканальная СМО с заданными распределениями\"\"\"\n",
    "    def __init__(self, env, N, M, lambda_val, mu, input_dist, output_dist):\n",
    "        self.env = env\n",
    "        self.N = N\n",
    "        self.M = M\n",
    "        self.lambda_val = lambda_val\n",
    "        self.mu = mu\n",
    "        self.input_dist = input_dist\n",
    "        self.output_dist = output_dist\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.servers = simpy.Resource(env, capacity=N)\n",
    "        self.queue = simpy.Store(env, capacity=M)\n",
    "\n",
    "        self.completed = 0\n",
    "        self.lost = 0\n",
    "        self.wait_times = []\n",
    "        self.system_times = []\n",
    "\n",
    "    def generate_interarrival(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Генерация интервала между поступлениями\"\"\"\n",
    "        if self.input_dist == \"M\":\n",
    "            return np.random.exponential(1 / self.lambda_val)\n",
    "        elif self.input_dist == \"E_2\":\n",
    "            # Сумма 2 экспонент\n",
    "            phase1 = np.random.exponential(1 / (2 * self.lambda_val))\n",
    "            phase2 = np.random.exponential(1 / (2 * self.lambda_val))\n",
    "            return phase1 + phase2\n",
    "        elif self.input_dist == \"E_3\":\n",
    "            # Сумма 3 экспонент\n",
    "            phases = np.random.exponential(1 / (3 * self.lambda_val), 3)\n",
    "            return np.sum(phases)\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            return np.random.exponential(1 / self.lambda_val)\n",
    "\n",
    "    def generate_service_time(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Генерация времени обслуживания\"\"\"\n",
    "        if self.output_dist == \"M\":\n",
    "            return np.random.exponential(1 / self.mu)\n",
    "        elif self.output_dist == \"E_2\":\n",
    "            phase1 = np.random.exponential(1 / (2 * self.mu))\n",
    "            phase2 = np.random.exponential(1 / (2 * self.mu))\n",
    "            return phase1 + phase2\n",
    "        elif self.output_dist == \"E_3\":\n",
    "            phases = np.random.exponential(1 / (3 * self.mu), 3)\n",
    "            return np.sum(phases)\n",
    "        else:\n",
    "            return np.random.exponential(1 / self.mu)\n",
    "\n",
    "    def request(self, job_id):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Обработка заявки\"\"\"\n",
    "        arrival_time = self.env.now\n",
    "\n",
    "        # Пытаемся получить сервер\n",
    "        with self.servers.request() as req:\n",
    "            # Если нет свободного сервера, проверяем очередь\n",
    "            if self.servers.count == self.N:\n",
    "                if len(self.queue.items) >= self.M:\n",
    "                    # Очередь заполнена - отказ\n",
    "                    self.lost += 1\n",
    "                    return\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Ставим в очередь или сразу начинаем обслуживание\n",
    "            if self.servers.count == self.N:\n",
    "                # Ждём в очереди\n",
    "                yield self.queue.put(job_id)\n",
    "                yield req\n",
    "                yield self.queue.get()\n",
    "            else:\n",
    "                yield req\n",
    "\n",
    "            wait_time = self.env.now - arrival_time\n",
    "            self.wait_times.append(wait_time)\n",
    "\n",
    "            # Обслуживание\n",
    "            service_time = self.generate_service_time()\n",
    "            yield self.env.timeout(service_time)\n",
    "\n",
    "            self.system_times.append(self.env.now - arrival_time)\n",
    "            self.completed += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "    def generate_jobs(self):\n",
    "        \"\"\"Генератор заявок\"\"\"\n",
    "        job_id = 0\n",
    "        while True:\n",
    "            interarrival = self.generate_interarrival()\n",
    "            yield self.env.timeout(interarrival)\n",
    "            self.env.process(self.request(f\"job_{job_id}\"))\n",
    "            job_id += 1\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "def run_multiserver_simulation(N, M, lambda_val, mu, input_dist, output_dist, sim_time=50000):\n",
    "    \"\"\"Запуск имитационного моделирования многоканальной СМО\"\"\"\n",
    "    env = simpy.Environment()\n",
    "    system = MultiServerQueue(env, N, M, lambda_val, mu, input_dist, output_dist)\n",
    "    env.process(system.generate_jobs())\n",
    "    env.run(until=sim_time)\n",
    "    return system\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nЗапуск моделирования многоканальной СМО ({input_dist}/{output_dist})...\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • N={N}, M={M}, λ={lambda_val2:.4f}, μ={mu2:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Время моделирования: 50000 ед.времени\")\n",
    "\n",
    "sim_system = run_multiserver_simulation(N, M, lambda_val2, mu2, input_dist, output_dist)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nРЕЗУЛЬТАТЫ МОДЕЛИРОВАНИЯ:\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"  • Обслужено заявок: {sim_system.completed}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Потеряно заявок: {sim_system.lost}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Вероятность потери: {sim_system.lost/(sim_system.completed+sim_system.lost):.4f}\")\n",
    "\n",
    "W_sim = np.mean(sim_system.system_times) if sim_system.system_times else 0\n",
    "Wq_sim = np.mean(sim_system.wait_times) if sim_system.wait_times else 0\n",
    "L_sim = (sim_system.completed / 50000) * W_sim\n",
    "Lq_sim = (sim_system.completed / 50000) * Wq_sim\n",
    "A_sim = sim_system.completed / 50000\n",
    "\n",
    "print(f\"\\nХАРАКТЕРИСТИКИ (по результатам моделирования):\")\n",
    "print(\"-\" * 60)\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее время в системе (W): {W_sim:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее количество заявок (L): {L_sim:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Среднее время в очереди (Wq): {Wq_sim:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Средняя длина очереди (Lq): {Lq_sim:.4f}\")\n",
    "print(f\"  • Пропускная способность (A): {A_sim:.4f}\")"
   ]
